description: Source code for the VersionGLSL class, which handles GLSL shader versioning and scanning shader code for specific features in the ANGLE project.

classes.name: TVersionGLSL
classes.description: Class responsible for determining GLSL shader version based on shader features and output type.

methods.name: ShaderOutputTypeToGLSLVersion
methods.description: Converts shader output type enum to corresponding GLSL version number.

methods.name: TVersionGLSL::TVersionGLSL
methods.description: Constructor that sets shader version based on output type and pragma directives.

methods.name: TVersionGLSL::visitSymbol
methods.description: Checks for usage of the gl_PointCoord built-in variable.

methods.name: TVersionGLSL::visitDeclaration
methods.description: Checks for invariant qualifiers in declarations.

methods.name: TVersionGLSL::visitGlobalQualifierDeclaration
methods.description: Ensures version is at least GLSL 1.20 when global qualifiers are declared.

methods.name: TVersionGLSL::visitFunctionPrototype
methods.description: Checks function parameters for array out/inout qualifiers.

methods.name: TVersionGLSL::visitAggregate
methods.description: Detects matrix constructor calls to adjust GLSL version.

methods.name: TVersionGLSL::ensureVersionIsAtLeast
methods.description: Updates the shader version to at least the specified version.
